llm.summary: This skill coherently documents a Google Tasks command interface with disclosed task-list and task mutation capabilities, and I found no hidden execution or persistence behavior.

dimensions.detail: Google Tasks account access is proportionate to the stated productivity purpose, and sensitive behavior is limited to the authenticated user's task data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a Markdown skill file requiring an existing gws binary; no bundled executable scripts, dependency installation, or remote payload retrieval are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to inspecting gws help/schema output and invoking gws tasks methods; they do not override agent behavior, hide actions, or request unrelated access.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background worker, privilege escalation, tool wrapping, memory writes, or cross-session modification behavior appears in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill is for managing Google Tasks through the gws CLI and clearly lists read, create, update, move, clear, and delete operations, including effects on assigned tasks in Docs or Chat Spaces.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this skill can guide an agent to create, update, move, clear, and delete Google Tasks data through your authenticated gws setup. Review commands before approving destructive actions, especially task-list deletion or deletion of assigned tasks that may also affect Docs or Chat Spaces.
